'''Garn Stewer''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who acted as [[chief]] [[Rebel technician|technician]] of the [[starship]] maintenance crew in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]'s [[Great Temple|base]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]]. His team maintained the Alliance's [[T-65 X-wing starfighter]]s, [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]]s, and [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft]]s, and Stewer made sure there was a symbiotic relationship between the [[rebel pilot]]s and ground crew in the base. The chief would often implore the pilots with exhausted futility to not damage "his" [[starfighter]]s; however, these complaints masked a good humor shared between Stewer and his crew and the pilots.<ref name="ROUVG" />

In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> he was present in the base's [[hangar]] when the criminal [[Jyn Erso]] was brought in to take part in [[Operation Fracture]].<ref name="RO" /> Between [[1 ABY]] and [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{IDWAdventuresCite-2020|issue=12|story=Squad Goals, Part 2}} features [[Rogue Squadron]] being led by [[Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker]]. Rogue Squadron formed during the [[Battle of Mako-Ta|Assault on the Mako-Ta Space Docks]], which ''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' dates to one [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' establishes marks the beginning of [[0 ABY]], and therefore the Assault on the [[Mako-Ta Space Docks]] must take place around [[1 ABY]]. ''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' and {{StoryCite|story=Rendezvous Point (short story)|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}} establish that [[Wedge Antilles]] replaced Luke as commander after the [[Battle of Hoth]], which ''Star Wars: Galactic Atlas'' dates to [[3 ABY]]. Therefore, the events of the comic must take place between 1 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]] and 3 ABY.</ref> Stewer served as [[hangar chief]] aboard the Rebel ship ''[[Home One]]''. He was working on disgraced pilot's [[Ibti Myrak]]'s [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]] when she tried to board it in an emergency. The pilot got into a verbal altercation with [[Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar]], and Stewer intervened. However, Myrak threw him off and left in her ship. Stewer then informed the admiral that she had jumped to [[hyperspace]] to save [[Rogue Squadron]] during the [[Ambush in the Valo system|ambush]] in the [[Valo system]]. When they returned, Stewer helped arrest double agent [[Lyle Kullan]].<ref name="Squad Goals II">{{IDWAdventuresCite-2020|issue=12|story=Squad Goals, Part 2}}</ref>

At one point, the chief sired a child, named [[Garn Stewer, Jr.]] who served as an [[RZ-2 A-wing interceptor|A-wing]] [[Resistance pilot|pilot]] for the [[Resistance]].<ref name="ROTSVD" />

Stewer had [[Color|brown]] [[hair]] and [[eye]]s and fair skin.<ref name="RO" /> While in the base he wore a synthetic fabric [[Clothing|boilersuit]] and a variant of the standard Alliance service [[Hat|helmet]] with a [[comlink]] but no visor.<ref name="ROUVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Garn Stewer first appeared in the film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', which was released in North America on [[December 16]], [[2016]]. Stewer was not identified in the film, but received a name in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released in conjunction with the film.
